lead: Sridevi was an Indian film actor, born on 13 August 1963 in Sivakasi.
She died on 24 February 2018 in Dubai at the age of 54.
She is associated with work such as Mr. India, Chandni and English Vinglish and has been recognised with Padma Shri in arts and Stardust Award for Best Drama Actress.
This profile collects the Sridevi facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Sridevi — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Sridevi was born on 13 August 1963 in Sivakasi, and holds Indian nationality. She was given the name Shree Amma Yanger Ayyapan at birth and is publicly known as Sridevi.
She is recorded as speaking Hindi, Telugu, Tamil and English.

sections.heading: Sridevi — Career and Professional Work
paras: Her professional record lists film actor, film producer and manufacturer as her occupations.
Among the credits most often linked to Sridevi are Mr. India, Chandni and English Vinglish.

sections.heading: Sridevi — Family, Marriage and Personal Life
paras: She has been married to Boney Kapoor (married 1996, until 2018) and Mithun Chakraborty (married 1985, until 1988).
She is a parent to Janhvi Kapoor and Khushi Kapoor.
She is associated with Mumbai as a place of residence.

sections.heading: Sridevi — Net Worth: What Is Actually Verifiable
paras: Net-worth figures for Sridevi circulate widely online, but almost none of them come from an audited or officially published source. BioStar does not invent or repeat unsourced numbers, so no dollar figure is stated on this page.

What can be said from the public record is where her income is likely to originate: professional work as a film actor, film producer and manufacturer, brand partnerships, sponsored social content and project fees and royalties from credited work.
If a verified figure is published by a credible outlet — a company filing, an election affidavit, or an official disclosure — this section will be updated with the source attached.
